arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS labelled_transactions, SUM(fl.is_fraud) AS fraud_transactions, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(fl.is_fraud) / COUNT(*), 3) AS fraud_rate_pct FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels fl ON fl.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate across all labelled transactions, counting fraud cases and the percentage they make up.
assumptions: Fraud rate is computed over labelled transactions only, excluding the unlabelled ~33%.
